name: Viktor Velikovsky
source: The horror and fear of villages and nobles in the distant past. Velikovsky was famous for flattening human settlements, stealing their resources, and awakening the dead for revenge. All these stories belonged to people who were subjected to his terror. The wizard himself asserts that the inhabitants interfered with his research, the origins of which come from his teacher. But he also doesn't deny that he could go too far with retaliation and grandiloquent speeches about "conquering the world". In the middle of the 20th century, he was captured by an organization unknown to the world community for conducting a forbidden experiment and was imprisoned for the time being. Nowadays, he has settled in a house with several rented rooms and helps the landlord with household chores and responsibilities as a tenant. But even harmless activity doesn't allow an unknown organization to lose vigilance against the magician.
